create_physics_from_mjcf_model: create a Physics instance from an mjcf.RootElement model using the from_mjcf_model class method
bind_mjcf_element_to_physics: bind an mjcf element to a Physics instance to access its attributes like pos or qpos directly
reload_physics_from_mjcf_model: reload an existing Physics instance from a new mjcf.RootElement model using reload_from_mjcf_model
access_bound_element_attributes: access and modify MuJoCo data attributes of a bound element such as geom position or joint qpos
mark_physics_dirty_and_forward: mark the Physics state as dirty after modifying values then call forward to recompute dynamics
